summary: The 8-K filed by Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. (AITX) on April 24, 2026, reports a press release announcing that its subsidiary, RAD, received a 16-unit ROSA order for multi-site construction deployment. No merger, acquisition, spin-off, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, or other special situation is mentioned. The event is a routine product sales announcement with no structural corporate changes or financial engineering. The new order is expected to generate ~$13,500 in monthly and $162,000 in annual recurring revenue. No deal terms or strategic review process is disclosed. This filing is a standard current report for a commercial win, not a special situation.
